mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teaching_work WHERE work_file=#{file.id} OR work_cover=#{file.id}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_file WHERE id != #{file.id} AND file_path=#{file.filePath} AND file_location=#{file.fileLocation}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',course_icon,course_cover,course_map,course_desc) AS links FROM teaching_course UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',unit_cover,course_video,course_case,course_ppt,course_work,course_work_answer,course_plan,unit_intro,media_content) FROM teaching_course_unit UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',work_cover,work_document_url,work_url,work_desc) FROM teaching_additional_work UNION ALL SELECT h.data_content FROM sys_data_log h JOIN teaching_work w ON w.id=h.data_id WHERE h.data_table='teaching_work' UNION ALL SELECT avatar FROM sys_user UNION ALL SELECT config_value FROM sys_config UNION ALL SELECT news_content FROM teaching_news UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',asset_data,md5_ext) FROM teaching_scratch_assets ) resource_links WHERE LOCATE(#{file.filePath}, links)>0 OR LOCATE(#{file.id}, links)>0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='teaching_course_media'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_course_media WHERE LOCATE(#{file.filePath},media_path)>0 OR LOCATE(#{file.id},media_path)>0

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT course_icon v1,course_cover v2,course_map v3,course_desc v4,NULL v5,NULL v6,NULL v7,NULL v8,NULL v9 FROM teaching_course UNION ALL SELECT unit_cover,course_video,course_case,course_ppt,course_work,course_work_answer,course_plan,unit_intro,media_content FROM teaching_course_unit UNION ALL SELECT work_cover,work_document_url,work_url,work_desc,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM teaching_additional_work UNION ALL SELECT h.data_content,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM sys_data_log h JOIN teaching_work w ON w.id=h.data_id WHERE h.data_table='teaching_work' UNION ALL SELECT avatar,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM sys_user UNION ALL SELECT config_value,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM sys_config UNION ALL SELECT news_content,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM teaching_news UNION ALL SELECT asset_data,md5_ext,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM teaching_scratch_assets ) resource_links WHERE LOCATE('%',CONCAT_WS(',',v1,v2,v3,v4,v5,v6,v7,v8,v9))>0 OR LOCATE('&',CONCAT_WS(',',v1,v2,v3,v4,v5,v6,v7,v8,v9))>0 OR LOCATE(CHAR(92),CONCAT_WS(',',v1,v2,v3,v4,v5,v6,v7,v8,v9))>0
SELECT media_path v1 FROM teaching_course_media WHERE LOCATE('%',media_path)>0 OR LOCATE('&',media_path)>0 OR LOCATE(CHAR(92),media_path)>0
